The complete chamber, neutral-simplex frequency and integer-minimal witness add structural information beyond a single counterexample.

final_claim: For pure Webster apportionment with positive shares and strict cutoffs, the coordinatewise first quota failure occurs with four entities and three seats; after relabeling the violating entity \(A\), the complete chamber is \(5/8<p_A\le2/3\) with every rival below \(p_A/5\), its uniform-simplex probability is \(1/1350\), and the unique least-total positive-integer witness is (6,1,1,1) up to permutation.
limitations: Pure apportionment without statutory one-seat minima.
